system.description: When riding large Beasts such as Sith Warbirds, the Sith frequently use special battle harnesses, turning the Beasts into mobile weapon platforms. The Sith Battle Harness features a cockpit that provides the rider Improved Cover, and the special reins grant a +2 Equipment bonus on Ride checks. In addition, the mount gains a +4 Equipment bonus to it's Reflex Defense and it's Fortitude Defense. The Sith Battle Harness also has a built-in Blaster Cannon, powered by an onboard Power Generator providing unlimited ammunition.

holocron.sourceBook: Star Wars Saga Edition Jedi Academy Training Manual
